gaps.sentence: Don't worry, I ___ you with the boxes as soon as I arrive.
gaps.hint: a promise made about the future
gaps.explanation: A promise about the future uses 'will' in the main clause: will help.

gaps.hint: how long plus since needs present perfect
gaps.explanation: 'How long' questions about periods that include the present take the present perfect: have you known.

gaps.sentence: I ___ the dentist on Thursday afternoon — I booked it last week.
gaps.explanation: A personal arrangement already made takes the present continuous: am seeing.

gaps.sentence: As soon as the plane landed, everyone ___ their phones.
gaps.hint: as soon as links two past actions
gaps.explanation: 'As soon as' links two sequential completed actions, so the past simple is used: switched on.

gaps.sentence: She ___ her keys again — this is the third time this month!
gaps.hint: third time this month connects to now
gaps.explanation: 'This is the third time' links a recent event to now, so the present perfect is required: has lost.

gaps.sentence: By the end of the month, they ___ the new bridge.
gaps.hint: by the end of means completed before
gaps.explanation: An action completed before a specific future point takes the future perfect: will have finished.

gaps.sentence: Who ___ this bag belong to? It has been sitting here all morning.
gaps.hint: the question form needs auxiliary does
gaps.explanation: Present simple questions need the auxiliary 'does' plus the base verb: does this bag belong to.

gaps.sentence: When I got to the office, I realised I ___ my security pass.
gaps.hint: the forgetting happened before realising it
gaps.explanation: The forgetting happened before the past moment of realising, so the past perfect is needed: had forgotten.
